title: Richards Fixed-Horizon Error-Bound Estimator Qualification
purpose: Determine whether same-horizon Richards endpoint defects can be converted into a conservative dimensional upper bound on remaining endpoint head error. This work unit does not choose an application/scientific temporal tolerance and does not admit production use.

protocol_revision_after_attempt1.failure: The first calibration case completed the common refinement levels through N=512 with exact mass closure and then failed before producing the N=1024 endpoint required by the attempted universal N=2048 reference.
protocol_revision_after_attempt1.scientific_interpretation: The failure occurred after the common-ladder endpoint sequence had reached the frozen floating-point floor. Forcing every case deeper therefore mixes temporal-reference qualification with avoidable nonlinear over-refinement and can reject a numerically resolved case for lack of a physically more informative finite reference.
protocol_revision_after_attempt1.revision_rule: Every case first runs the frozen common ladder N=[1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512]. If both final common-ladder head defects d_128=|x_128-x_256| and d_256=|x_256-x_512| are at or below the frozen machine floor, N=512 is the finite reference for that case. Otherwise the case must run the extended ladder through N=1024 and N=2048 and N=2048 is its finite reference. Any required extended-ladder nonconvergence is qualification failure.
protocol_revision_after_attempt1.data_snooping_guard: Attempt 1 stopped on calibration case 1 before q_cap, Nmin, a bound multiplier, a scientific tolerance, or a held-out result was derived. Calibration states, jumps, horizons, held-out states, held-out jumps and held-out horizons remain unchanged. The revised reference-depth rule is frozen before Attempt 2 calibration execution.

mathematical_candidate.endpoint_family: x_N is the Richards endpoint state obtained over the same physical [t0,t1] using N equal internal substeps
mathematical_candidate.contraction_ratio: q_N = d_2N/d_N when both defects are above the numerical floor
mathematical_candidate.candidate_global_cap: q_cap is derived only from the frozen calibration matrix as the maximum resolved q_N at and beyond a candidate minimum refinement depth Nmin
mathematical_candidate.two_trajectory_bound_target: For x_2N, B_2N = q_cap/(1-q_cap) * d_N, conditional on the independently tested profile assumption that every future defect contracts by no more than q_cap.
mathematical_candidate.qualification_test: B_2N must upper-bound the observed max-head error of x_2N against the case-specific finite same-horizon reference selected by the frozen floor-aware reference protocol for every resolved calibration and held-out case, while all future resolved q values also remain <= q_cap.
mathematical_candidate.numerical_floor_branch: If d_N is at or below the frozen machine floor, the case is not used to derive q_cap. At the candidate Nmin it passes only as floor-dominated when the observed x_2N-to-selected-finite-reference head error is also at or below that same floor; otherwise the candidate Nmin fails. No additive floor is silently inserted into B_2N.
not_claimed: N=512 or N=2048 is an exact analytical solution
geometric contraction is a theorem for Richards flow
q_cap is universal outside the frozen profile
B_2N is a scientific/application acceptance tolerance
floating-point floor is a scientific error tolerance

frozen_numerics.floor_resolved_reference_rule: Use N=512 only when both d_128 and d_256 from the common ladder are <= the frozen machine floor; otherwise N=2048 is mandatory.

gate_A_calibration.role: derive candidate Nmin and q_cap only
gate_A_calibration.selection_rule: For each candidate Nmin in [1,2,4,8,16,32,64], derive q_cap as the maximum resolved future contraction ratio over all calibration cases from Nmin onward within each case's frozen available refinement sequence. The first Nmin with finite q_cap<1 and conservative B_2N for every resolved calibration case, plus the frozen floor-dominated rule for unresolved cases, is the sole Gate B candidate. No rounding, safety factor or manually chosen margin may be added.

gate_B_held_out.role: independent falsification of the frozen Gate A Nmin and q_cap
pass_conditions: all trajectories required by the frozen floor-aware finite-reference protocol converge
hard mass gate passes for every trajectory
every resolved future q_N at and beyond frozen Nmin is <= frozen q_cap
B_2N computed only from d_N and frozen q_cap is >= observed max-head error of x_2N against the selected finite reference for every resolved case
any d_N at numerical floor satisfies the separately frozen floor-dominated rule
no held-out-dependent adjustment of Nmin, q_cap, matrix, floor rule, finite-reference rule or formula

finite_reference_controls.floor_resolved_tail_diagnostic: report max-head difference x_256 versus x_512
finite_reference_controls.extended_tail_diagnostic: report max-head difference x_1024 versus x_2048
finite_reference_controls.interpretation: A bound pass is relative to the finite same-horizon reference selected by the frozen protocol. The N=512 branch is admitted only after two consecutive common-ladder defects are already at or below the machine floor. The N=2048 branch remains mandatory otherwise. Neither finite reference is treated as analytical truth.

cost_boundary.production_candidate_if_bound_qualifies: two same-horizon trajectories at Nmin and 2*Nmin are sufficient to evaluate B_2N if the frozen contraction profile itself is admitted later
